purpose: Record the real reboot/activation boundary without assuming that installed XOVI files or a transient bridge service imply boot activation.
owner_steps_before_approval: Save and close all tablet work using normal stock controls
Reboot the tablet using its normal power menu; do not install a firmware update
Wait for normal Library startup, then connect PC USB
Explicitly approve only this exact read-only probe after those steps

script.host_missing_approval_smoke: exit1 before root/device checks; exact rejection message
script.host_wrong_approval_smoke: exit1 before root/device checks; exact rejection message

read_only_scope: Check tested IMG_VERSION3.28.0.172 and original stock Xochitl SHA-256
Verify exact owned capsule marker and current client/QML/runtime/public-CA/QMD/adapter/backup/quarantined-module checksums; no credential or notebook contents
Verify the original upstream webserver-remote.so remains absent from extensions.d
Read only a SHA-256 of private pairing/association state, never its contents
Read the existing owned unit invocation record, validate it as a32-hex identifier
Record current boot ID and uptime; no before/after boot-ID comparison is claimed because no pre-reboot boot ID was collected
Query only the named owned bridge unit and Xochitl service state; no PID/process scans or journal dumps
Read the two known UDC controller states
Report only listening addresses for stock ports80/81 and the bridge UI9821 from kernel socket tables
expected_not_claimed: The bridge service was observed transient and is not boot-enabled. It may be absent/offline after reboot. Installed-file verification alone is not an activation pass. Actual probe results determine any separately proposed repair.

preserved_request_state_before_owner_reb.desktop_coordinator: Keep ink-native-origin-0091 alive; do not cancel B or close its originating session

later_repairs: Not approved by this proposal. Any service start, XOVI activation, restart or restoration requires its own actual-state-based hash-pinned script and fresh owner approval.
remaining_acceptance: Record actual reboot behavior; preserve terminal cancellation; perform separately approved restoration and baseline verification. Firmware updates remain untested, not implied safe. Ticket01 is not complete.
